nearbyApps.name: Replica Compass
nearbyApps.desc: Classify rough read/write workload notes with real local MiniLM inference. Review counts and node assumptions, enumerate intersecting quorums under an offline-node target, compare assumed latency with all-node acknowledgements and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads or configuration changes.

nearbyApps.name: Quorum Canopy
nearbyApps.desc: Reconcile both ends of rough proxy notes with real local MiniLM member inference. Verify mandates, trace chains to attending representatives, block cycles and cap breaches, compare weighted quorum against direct attendance and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads or votes.

nearbyApps.name: Capacity Commons
nearbyApps.desc: Match rough shared-service usage notes with real local MiniLM inference. Review resource, team and units; compare exact tier-cost Shapley contributions with equal splitting, preserve every held record and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads or billing actions.

distinction: Quorum Canopy traces attendance proxies; Capacity Commons allocates costs by Shapley. Swing Commons enumerates weighted yes/no voting coalitions and exact Banzhaf pivotal power vs nominal weight share. No proxy or cost allocation.
input: group dictionary, informal distinct voting blocks, integer weights and pass quota
bottleneck: paraphrased mandate reconciliation and exhaustive decisive-coalition bookkeeping
ai: MiniLM neural group retrieval before mandatory identity/weight review
output: complete source audit, power and coalition witness CSVs, JSON and Markdown
